published_statement: 387 batteries and 310705 samples cover four datasets with diverse chemistries/protocols
independent_conclusion: 387发布CSV、310705原始行确实相符；清洗后303952行/303565相邻对。MIT125文件不是已证明的125纯净物理电池，原始MAT未取得。
decision_rule: Audit four sources and count batteries/samples under explicit row/cycle/pair definitions. Report count agreement only; no diversity inference from file count alone.

published_statement: 55 XJTU cells have six protocol-dependent degradation trajectory groups
evidence_figures_tables: Fig. 2;Fig. S1;Fig. S2;Fig. S3;Fig. S4;Table S1
independent_conclusion: 55发布轨迹映射六组并重绘；原始曲线说明容量测试/插值边界，六批均为独立测量完整容量的说法不成立。
decision_rule: All55 XJTU trajectories must map to six documented groups. Replot capacities; label periodically measured/interpolated capacity.

published_statement: Short pre-full-charge current/voltage windows support generally applicable features
independent_conclusion: 262原始电池225128发布行的14个非斜率有限特征按固定约定全匹配；MIT381镜像周期抽查支持14特征精度，两斜率和MIT原MAT/电流单位仍未解决。
decision_rule: Separate successful training on provided features from independently extracted feature agreement. Raw I/V/time are required for the latter; kurtosis convention conflict remains unresolved until checked.

published_statement: Feature-SOH correlation pattern may depend more on chemistry than protocol
independent_conclusion: Fig3b176/176打印两位小数相符；化学体系比协议更重要仅为有混杂的描述，不构成因果识别。
decision_rule: Compute11x16 Pearson coefficients and show chemistry/protocol group comparisons. Similarity is exploratory support only; causal chemistry interpretation is unavailable without controls.

published_statement: PINN has smallest regular estimation error in most settings
evidence_figures_tables: Fig. 4a;Fig. 4b;Table 2;Table S2;Table S3;Table S4;Table S5;Table S6
independent_conclusion: 标签单调PINN每个指标9/11低于两基线，合27/33；MIT/HUST均未优于任一基线。预测单调为0/33，不能合并成同一PINN结论。
decision_rule: For11 complete regular groups compare PINN to both baselines for MAE/MAPE/RMSE. Report each win/tie/loss and total; 'most' means strictly more than half of the33 group-metric cells. No universal claim.

published_statement: PINN is more stable across tasks and metrics
independent_conclusion: 标签单调31/33组指标样本SD低于两基线，预测单调33/33；ddof0方向相同。较小SD不说明平均误差较小或统计显著。
decision_rule: Compare repeat SD for all33 regular group-metric cells, separately ddof0/ddof1. Report win/tie/loss; smaller mean error alone does not establish stability.

published_statement: PINN inference F and MLP have same structure and parameter count; CNN similar; CPU inference timing is reported
independent_conclusion: F与MLP均7781，CNN8465；正式batch1000×1000forward、50预热、五独立进程。1线程F/MLP/CNN0.3895/0.3821/10.5312ms，2线程0.4543/0.4566/7.9500ms；硬件软件异于论文，不称精确速度复现。
decision_rule: Match architecture and parameter counts exactly; CPU timing is descriptive unless hardware/software match. Report measured setup and ratio, not an exact timing claim on different cloud CPU.

published_statement: PINN performs best in the tested small-sample settings
independent_conclusion: 标签单调MAPE/RMSE各25/28同时优于两基线，RWn1/HUSTn1/HUSTn4输MLP但全28均胜CNN；预测单调各5/28胜两基线。
decision_rule: For all28 small-sample group/n cells compare three models on MAPE/RMSE. A best-in-all statement requires no loss; otherwise report the supported subset and counterexamples.

published_statement: Performance generally improves as more training batteries are used
independent_conclusion: 标签单调RMSE7/7 n4低于n1、5/7严格逐步下降；预测单调4/7首末下降、1/7逐步下降；MLP/CNN14/14首末下降、8/14逐步下降。
decision_rule: For each group/model report n1->n4 error change and each adjacent change. General improvement uses negative endpoint difference in more than half of compared settings; strict monotonicity requires every adjacent difference <=0.

published_statement: One-battery PINN can approach MLP/CNN using three or four batteries
independent_conclusion: XJTU1/HUST主图合8个n1对n3/n4基线RMSE比较，标签单调4/8胜（XJTU全胜、HUST全输），预测单调2/8胜；无预设等效界值。
decision_rule: Report RMSE(PINN n1)-RMSE(MLP/CNN n3/n4) for XJTU1/HUST. Nonpositive is an empirical outperform/tie; positive cannot be declared equivalent because paper specifies no equivalence margin.

published_statement: All six XJTU batches have three-model small-sample results for one to four batteries, ten repeats
independent_conclusion: 六批三模型口径720运行已齐，另预测单调240运行；batch1重叠不重复计；全部11组实际测试CSV与论文精确ID集合/数量一致。
decision_rule: Require6 batches x4 sizes x3 models x10 independent repeats, with batch1 overlap counted once, and all exact test IDs checked.

published_statement: Fine-tuning with frozen G improves on source-only target evaluation
independent_conclusion: 复现源权重两损失均12/12方向平均改善，单次改善标签111/120、预测120/120。作者源权重标签11/12（111/120）、预测8/12（85/120）；48组均冻结G并更新F。
decision_rule: For each of12 directions pair each fine-tune with its own source-only target predictions. Require fixed-G identical hashes and F update; report RMSE change and repeats improved. Support for all directions requires all12 mean differences <0.

published_statement: One target battery plus pretraining can outperform one target battery from scratch
independent_conclusion: 冻结原报告保留严格未匹配；独立schema补充核640任务/960逐重复均通过，96候选匹配。n1的48比较中20低于/28高于target-only，依损失和源模式分列；方法超参差异仍保留，无显著性/等效性。
decision_rule: For12 directions compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n1. Require identical target tests, training battery, seed convention, validation and numerical protocol; otherwise label unmatched and do not infer improvement.

published_statement: For XJTU/TJU, one-battery fine-tuning may outperform two-battery target-only training
independent_conclusion: schema补充匹配后，XJTU1/TJU3 n2范围24比较仅7低于、17高于target-only。不能泛称一电池微调优于二电池训练；同seed/测试/训练前缀/数值环境已核，方法超参并非消融控制。
decision_rule: For directions targeting XJTU1/TJU3 compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n2 and list every direction. Report direction-specific outcomes; broad all-target wording is not assumed.

published_statement: Same-chemistry transfer directions appear more promising
independent_conclusion: 完整迁移矩阵和化学标签可用于描述；MIT/HUST同属LFP但目标难度、源误差与预训练源混杂，不能推断化学相同保证迁移更好。
decision_rule: Report chemistry-class effects for the complete transfer matrix with target difficulty and source error. Exploratory associations cannot establish chemistry as the cause or guarantee transfer.

published_statement: Overall reported MAPE is 0.87 percent
independent_conclusion: 标签PINN样本池化0.865541%四舍五入为0.87%，十一组等权1.029010%、四数据集等权0.988243%、82CSV等权1.087376%；原论文总体权重不明，不能把池化打印相符解释为原协议权重已恢复。预测PINN四权重4.6697%–5.5308%。
decision_rule: Report dataset-equal, batch-equal, battery-equal and sample-pooled PINN MAPE. Label0.87% headline reproduced only under an explicitly stated aggregation; original overall weighting is unspecified.

published_statement: Data, PDE and monotonicity losses define the proposed PINN
independent_conclusion: 原作者当前损失relu((u2-u1)*(y1-y2))、发布标签损失relu(y2-y1)、预测单调relu(u2-u1)不同；标签项参数梯度恒零。只比较实现不能证明物理项贡献。
decision_rule: Audit actual formulas and parameter gradients. Distinguish current author loss, publication label-only loss (zero model gradient), and prediction monotonicity; each is a separate protocol. No loss-importance conclusion without added labeled ablation.

published_statement: G contains transferable degradation dynamics
independent_conclusion: 48组G不变/F更新证据均通过；source-only改善依源模式/损失，支持部分可复用预测结构，不识别真实电化学机制。
decision_rule: Require unchanged-G hashes, changed-F proof and improved transfer versus source-only. This supports usefulness of reused dynamics only; electrochemical identifiability remains unavailable.

published_statement: Feature selection and cross-battery testing are intended to avoid leakage
independent_conclusion: 43组样本split保持tensor且验证x1标签68.50%–84.47%作为训练x2被PINN直接使用；CSV级独立测试不等于MIT物理身份独立（1256/14170测试点身份见过训练）。另每整电池全寿命minmax含测试未来极值。未量化各项性能偏差。
decision_rule: Audit test identities, disjoint batteries, normalization fit scope and checkpoint selection. Report demonstrated controls and remaining unknowns; design rationale alone cannot prove absence of all leakage.

published_statement: First-order derivatives balance accuracy and computational complexity
independent_conclusion: 源码确用u_t/u_x一阶导，未做导数阶数消融；准确率/复杂度折中更优不能由代码存在推得。
decision_rule: Source audit can verify first derivatives are used. No accuracy/complexity superiority without derivative-order comparison; publication reports no such ablation.

published_statement: Physical knowledge helps models learn better and faster and may support BMS development
independent_conclusion: 精度优势依实现/任务而变，标签单调项零梯度；无匹配收敛时间实验或BMS部署证据。调度效率不能当模型学得更快。
decision_rule: Summarize supported regular/small/transfer results. Faster learning requires matched convergence/work/time evidence; BMS usefulness requires deployment testing. Scheduler throughput is not model-learning evidence.
